name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An automated reviewer that reads every pull request and leaves line-by-line comments catching bugs and security holes, so human reviewers spend less time on the boring parts.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company who is losing developer hours to slow, inconsistent code review and wants security issues caught before merge.
business_use_cases: A software agency runs it on every client pull request to guarantee a baseline security and quality check before a human ever looks at the code.
A fintech or healthcare company self-hosts it to satisfy compliance requirements that all code is checked for SQL injection and XSS before release.
A dev-tools startup wraps it as a hosted SaaS add-on for teams that don't want to run their own LLM infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Host a managed version with per-seat pricing for teams that don't want to self-host the infrastructure.
Offer a compliance-report add-on (exportable security findings per PR) sold to regulated industries.

steal_this: A 'security review bot for hire': set this up as a hosted service, connect it to a client's repo over a weekend, and sell monthly access as an always-on second reviewer.
